{{Short description|Approach to teaching mathematics that emphasizes the use of computers}}

<!-- Deleted image removed: [[File:CBME11.gif|frame|<div style='text-align: center;'>'''Sets of Mathematics, Education, and Computers'''</div>]] -->

'''Computer-based mathematics education''' ('''CBME''') is an approach to [[teaching mathematics]] that emphasizes the use of computers and [[mathematical software]].

== Computers in math education ==
Computers are used in education in a number of ways, such as interactive [[tutorials]], [[hypermedia]], [[simulation]]s and [[educational games]].<ref name="MfL">{{citation|title = Multimedia for Learning|author = Stephen M. Alessi, Stanley R. Trollip|url = https://books.google.com/books?id=mmruAAAAMAAJ|isbn = 978-0-205-27691-2|year = 2001|publisher = Allyn and Bacon}} </ref> Tutorials are types of software that present information, check learning by question/answer method, judge responses, and provide feedback.<ref name=MfL/> Educational games are more like simulations and are used from the elementary to college level.<ref name=MfL/> [[E learning]] systems can deliver math lessons and exercises and manage homework assignments.

== Computer-based mathematics ==

* [[Computer algebra]] - [[computer algebra system]]s, [[list of computer algebra systems]], [[List of free and open-source software packages#Computer algebra systems|free computer algebra software]].
* [[Computational geometry]] - [[list of interactive geometry software]], [[list of information graphics software]], [[List of free and open-source software packages#Plotting software|free plotting software]].
* [[Computational statistics]] - [[list of statistical software]], [[comparison of statistical packages]], [[Data mining#Software|data mining software]], [[analytics]].
* [[Data science]] - [[list of numerical-analysis software]], [[Machine learning#Software|machine learning software]], [[List of free and open-source software packages#Data science|list of open-source data science software]].
